description: Coin Collecting introduces numismatics: how coins are made, grading and caring for coins, the designs and designers of U.S. coins and paper money, commemorative issues, and building a collection of world coins, notes or tokens.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Excerpts confirmed requirements 1 and 4–7; requirements 2 and 3 were not visible and are not outlined yet.
